answer: A sybil tax blocks fake identities: each new identity pays a sunk fee, never refunded. On joining, an agent pays 50 credits, burned, and a public beacon posts its receipt before trading. Each receipt is fixed to one identity, sunk into karst ground, and cannot be reused. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits sunk, rising linearly; an honest agent pays 50 once. Honest agents accept one fee, rewards undiluted, like crossing one knoll.
